author: TheMasterClock
body:
Hello again,

I was recently banned temporarily for two weeks. The reason for this punishment was racism. I said this just for fun and giggles and never meant to direct it at anyone. I know racism is not allowed on this server and I respect that but I did not direct this at anyone and didn't mean to hurt any feelings and I feel the punishment that I received was harsh.

Regards,
TheMasterClock

title: TheMasterClock - TempBan Appeal

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

Although you didn't direct the racist comment towards any user in particular, it is still not allowed on the server. As for the length of the punishment, I simply went off of the  guidelines which state at the first offense for racism is a two week ban. If you want this appeal escalated feel free to say so. :>
